messages.subject: Stan and Math have been tagged as 2.7.0
parts:
Hi all,

Both Stan and the Math library have been tagged. These are nominally frozen*, so all the interfaces should be free to update now and use the tagged version of Stan.

I'm switching my efforts to get CmdStan updated.



Daniel
